lesson: Both trades failed due to over-reliance on local structure breakouts that lacked alignment with the broader trend, resulting in liquidity sweeps rather than trend continuations. The system is currently misinterpreting noise as structural shifts, failing to account for the lack of volume confirmation in the SMC framework.
adjustment: Require a minimum 20% increase in relative volume on the breakout candle before entering any position to filter out low-conviction liquidity grabs.
methodology_flag: Trust SMC liquidity sweeps less; prioritize volume profile confirmation over pure price action structure.
